entries.name: Tournament selection
entries.description: Samples k population indices with replacement and returns the objective-sense best sampled member.

entries.name: Truncation selection
entries.description: Ranks the population by objective sense and samples uniformly from the best configured fraction.

entries.name: Linear ranking selection
entries.description: Uses objective rank rather than raw objective magnitude, with selective pressure s in [1,2].

entries.name: Exponential ranking selection
entries.description: Assigns exponentially decaying weights by objective rank, avoiding raw-objective scaling assumptions.

entries.name: Fitness-proportionate selection with explicit weights
entries.description: Roulette-wheel sampling over user-supplied finite non-negative weights; no implicit objective-to-fitness transform is fabricated.

entries.name: One-point crossover
entries.description: Copies one prefix from each parent and exchanges the suffix after one interior cut.

entries.name: Two-point crossover
entries.description: Exchanges the half-open segment between two sampled cut positions.

entries.name: Uniform crossover
entries.description: Independently exchanges each locus with an explicit exchange probability.

entries.name: Partially mapped crossover (PMX)
entries.description: Preserves a copied permutation segment and resolves outside conflicts by repeated segment mapping.

entries.name: Order crossover (OX1)
entries.description: Copies one parent segment and fills remaining positions in the cyclic relative order of the other parent while skipping duplicates.

entries.name: Bounded Simulated Binary Crossover (SBX)
entries.description: Real-coded SBX with explicit finite lower/upper bounds and the bounded formulation widely used with NSGA-II.
entries.reference: Deb & Agrawal (1995); Deb et al. (2002) for bounded use

entries.name: Bit-flip mutation
entries.description: Flips each boolean locus independently with an explicit per-bit probability.

entries.name: Integer random-reset mutation
entries.description: Resamples a selected integer gene uniformly from its legal interval while excluding its current value whenever another value exists.

entries.name: Swap mutation
entries.description: Swaps two distinct sampled positions once per mutation invocation.

entries.name: Inversion mutation
entries.description: Reverses one sampled contiguous segment once per mutation invocation.

entries.name: Bounded Gaussian mutation
entries.description: Adds an independent Gaussian perturbation to selected coordinates and projects the result to explicit finite bounds.

entries.name: Bounded polynomial mutation
entries.description: Uses bounded polynomial mutation with an explicit distribution index and per-coordinate invocation probability.

entries.name: Generational replacement with optional elitism
entries.description: The v0.41 runtime copies E elites without re-evaluation and fills the remaining N-E positions with newly evaluated offspring.

entries.name: Steady-state replacement
entries.description: Reviewed as scientifically distinct from the current generation-snapshot lifecycle. A faithful implementation requires offspring to compete with an immediately updated population rather than only changing a final replacement policy.
entries.formula: Select parents from the current live population, create and evaluate a small number of offspring, immediately replace selected population members, then select subsequent parents from that updated population.
